question: Has the collective discussed Diginex's path to profitability given the M&A spend?

beat.line: The collective hasn't discussed this lately; this draws on outside sources.
beat.action: A folded paper document drifts down onto a cream chip and settles flat.

sources: On the community angle specifically: the collective hasn't had much recent discussion here, so the view below draws on outside sources.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: a folded paper document; a cream paper chip.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: A folded paper document drifts down onto a cream chip and settles flat.
Ends holding on the folded document.
No headline.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: none. No text appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The collective hasn't discussed this lately; this draws on outside sources.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, 2D motion design presented as a modern editorial paper collage, photographed flat under soft, neutral room light. The scene opens on a solid, flat block-color paper ground of soft violet that fills the entire 16:9 frame. The lighting is consistent from the upper left, causing every layered element to cast a small, soft shadow onto the surface below. On the first frame, a cream-colored matte paper chip with a visible paper texture and print dots slides into the lower two-thirds of the frame from the left with fast speed, exhibiting a slight overshoot before landing stably. Simultaneously, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a folded paper document enters from the top of the frame. This cutout features a rough, white torn-paper edge and is entirely blank and unmarked, with no lettering or symbols. The document drifts downward with a gentle, floating motion and settles flat directly on top of the cream paper chip. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the duration. The elements hold their position in a clear reading window for the remainder of the video, with a very subtle, slow-motion breathing loop as the paper layers shift almost imperceptibly. There is no on-screen text.

overall_soundscape: A crisp, tactile paper-slap sound occurs the moment the folded document lands on the chip. A short, sticky sound of tape being pressed down accompanies the final settling of the elements. These foley sounds are layered beneath the voiceover in a quiet, studio-like room environment.
